digest.component_or_area: workflow step registry and seam testing guards
propositions: Step registration via @register_step decorator occurs as an import side effect on a process-global STEP_REGISTRY dict, making missed registration imports invisible to schema validation, linters, and existing test_contracts.py iteration checks

Seam test assertions on module headroom (< 700 LOC) exist for gate_dispatch.py and orchestrator.py but are missing for plan_review/workflow_ops.py (794 LOC) and llm/config.py (793 LOC), which currently exceed the policy threshold

The stale assertion message in test_gate_dispatch_seam.py claims gate_dispatch.py holds three finalize_verdict call sites, but all five call sites have been moved to plan_review_recovery.py (3 sites) and plan_review/workflow_ops.py (2 sites)

In-process assertions on STEP_REGISTRY cannot detect missing registration imports because test modules already import rebar.llm.workflow.steps before the test runs, pre-populating the process-global registry

Gate-YAML step references (uses: field in gates/plan-review.yaml) cannot be validated statically because the schema treats it as free-form string and linters skip validation for unknown steps by design
